# PoetryMaster Project Instructions

## Project Overview
PoetryMaster is a poetry creation and management application with features for writing, editing, organizing and sharing poems. It includes support for multiple poetry formats, themes, and collaborative features.

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on clean, readable code structure
- Implement responsive design for web interface
- Follow modern development practices
- Prioritize user experience and accessibility
- Support multiple poetry formats (haiku, sonnet, free verse, etc.)
- Enable theme customization and collaborative editing

## Key Features to Implement
- Poetry editor with syntax highlighting
- Template system for different poetry formats
- Theme and styling options
- User management and sharing capabilities
- Search and organization features
- Export functionality

## Technical Considerations
- Use modern web technologies
- Implement proper data validation
- Ensure cross-platform compatibility
- Follow security best practices
- Optimize for performance

This file will be updated as the project develops with specific implementation details and requirements.
